definitions.lord_12: Lord of the 12th house from Lagna (vyaya / moksha sthana).
core_principles: A strong lord_12 (own sign or exalted anywhere) is GOOD - high expenditure implies high income.
A dusthana lord in another dusthana is a yoga (like kendra lord in kendra, trikona lord in trikona).
House 12 is the 8th from house 6, so a strong lord_12 weakens enemies.
definitions.sensitivity: Intimacy-related rules are for internal reference; present only in neutral, non-explicit wording to end users.

house_12_rules.result: Harmonious, moderate and refined marital intimacy.

house_12_rules.condition: malefic (Saturn, Rahu, Ketu, Mars) or retrograde planet in house 12
house_12_rules.result: Marital intimacy is NOT denied (common myth rejected); tends to be more intense / unconventional.
Judge by lord_12's placement and conjunctions; empty 12th is not harmful by itself.

house_12_rules.condition: house 12 empty AND lord_12 in kendra or trikona
house_12_rules.result: All comforts of life including marital harmony.

house_12_rules.name: 2nd vs 12th affliction
house_12_rules.result_a: Family discord/separation over visible issues (money, relatives).
house_12_rules.result_b: Discord/separation over private issues that are not spoken of openly.

results: Financially comfortable - spends because income supports it
Its dasa is the native's enjoyment period
Enemies weakened (12th is 8th from 6th)
rules.timing_note: Best when the dasa falls roughly between age 20 and 40.
